title: 第15章 夜探黑市第16章 手术刀的首战
lines: 白家大长老的卧房，光线昏暗，阴森森的有些瘆人。
窗户被厚重的黑布遮住，只点着几盏长明灯。
空气中弥漫浓重的药味，以及一股若有若无的、类似腐肉的腥臭气息。
林澈走到床榻前，仔细观察。
白家大长老，白世昌，看起来约莫六七十岁，面容枯槁，皮肤呈现不正常的灰青色，布满了细密的、蛛网般的黑色纹路。
这些纹路如同活物，在皮肤下缓慢蠕动、延伸。
最诡异的是他的胸口。
那里的衣物被剪开，露出一个拳头大小的“伤口”
不，那不是伤口，而是一个……洞。
洞内深不见底，隐约能看到某种半透明的、搏动着的东西嵌在胸腔深处。
洞口周围，延伸出无数细如发丝的黑色触须，扎入周围的皮肉、骨骼，甚至延伸向心脏和肺部。
赵虎只看了一眼，就差点吐出来。
林澈面不改色，开启“基础解剖视觉”
在他的视野中，白世昌体内的状况触目惊心：
那个“洞”
里嵌着的，是一枚拳头大小、通体漆黑、表面有暗绿色纹路流转的晶体。
晶体不断释放出诡异的能量波动，与他体内的金丹产生共鸣，同时分泌出黑色触须，试图与他的身体融合。
但融合失败了。
白世昌的金丹已经千疮百孔，布满裂纹，被黑色触须缠绕、侵蚀。
而他的身体组织，则在晶体能量的辐射下，发生着缓慢的“异化”
——部分细胞坏死，部分细胞畸变，部分细胞甚至出现了植物化特征。
这就像强行将一块外来的什么器官移植进体内，但发生了剧烈的排斥反应。
“这不是病。”
林澈心中明悟，“这是‘植入’。
他在尝试与那块‘黑石头’的碎片融合，借此修复金丹、冲击元婴。
但失败了，现在碎片正在反噬，要把他变成……某种东西。”
右手虚影微微震颤，传递信息：
「检测到高浓度‘法则污染源’碎片」
「污染类型：生命异化灵力畸变」
「污染等级：三级（可危及金丹修士）」
「建议：立即进行‘污染源切除手术’，否则宿主将在三十日内彻底异化，丧失人性」
虚影甚至给出了一个初步的手术方案：切开胸腔，分离黑色触须与重要器官的连接，完整取出污染晶体，然后清理残留污染，修复受损组织。
但成功率只有……四成。
而且手术过程中，一旦晶体暴走，或者白世昌的金丹崩溃，都可能当场毙命。
“林大夫，如何？”
白文远在身后悄声问道。
林澈转身，平静地说：“大长老的情况很复杂。
他体内嵌着一块异物，正在与他的金丹和身体融合，但发生了严重的排斥反应。
若不及时取出，最多一月，必死无疑。”
白文远脸色微变：“取出？怎么取？”

The bedroom of the eldest elder of the Bai family was dimly lit, eerie and a bit scary.
The windows were covered with heavy black cloth, and only a few long lamps were lit.
The air was filled with a strong smell of medicine, as well as a faint fishy smell, similar to that of rotten flesh.
Lin Che walked to the bed and observed it carefully.
The eldest elder of the Bai family, Bai Shichang, looks to be about sixty or seventy years old, with a haggard face and abnormal gray-green skin, covered with fine, spiderweb-like black lines.
These lines are like living things, slowly crawling and extending under the skin.
The weirdest thing is his chest.
The clothes there were cut open, revealing a "wound" the size of a fist.
No, it wasn't a wound, it was a... hole.
The cave was bottomless, and something translucent and pulsating could be vaguely seen embedded deep in the chest.
Around the hole, countless hair-thin black tentacles extend, piercing into the surrounding skin, bones, and even extending to the heart and lungs.
Zhao Hu almost vomited after just one glance.
Lin Che's expression remained unchanged as she activated "Basic Anatomy Vision"
In his field of vision, the situation inside Bai Shichang's body was shocking:
That "hole"
Embedded inside is a fist-sized, pitch-black crystal with dark green lines flowing on its surface.
The crystal continuously released strange energy fluctuations, which resonated with the golden elixir in his body, and at the same time secreted black tentacles, trying to merge with his body.
But the fusion failed.
Bai Shichang's golden elixir was riddled with holes, cracks, and was entangled and eroded by black tentacles.
And his body tissues are undergoing slow "alienation" under the radiation of crystal energy.
——Some cells are necrotic, some cells are deformed, and some cells even have plant-like characteristics.
It was like forcibly transplanting a foreign organ into the body, but severe rejection occurred.
"This is not a disease."
Lin Che understood clearly in her heart, "This is 'implantation'.
He is trying to fuse with the fragments of the 'black stone' to repair the golden elixir and impact the Nascent Soul.
It failed, and now the fragments are coming back to turn him into... something. "
The shadow on his right hand trembled slightly, conveying the message:
"High concentration of 'law pollution source' fragments detected"
"Type of pollution: life alienation and spiritual power distortion"
"Pollution level: Level 3 (can endanger Jindan monks)"
"Recommendation: Perform 'contamination source removal surgery' immediately, otherwise the host will be completely alienated and lose its humanity within thirty days."
Xuying even gave a preliminary surgical plan: cut open the chest, separate the connection between the black tentacles and the important organs, completely remove the contaminated crystal, then clean up the remaining contamination and repair the damaged tissue.
But the success rate is only... 40%.
Moreover, during the operation, if the crystal goes wild or Bai Shichang's golden elixir collapses, he may die on the spot.
"Doctor Lin, how are you doing?"
Bai Wenyuan asked quietly from behind.
Lin Che turned around and said calmly: "The situation of the Great Elder is very complicated.
There was a foreign object embedded in his body, which was fusing with his golden elixir and body, but a severe rejection reaction occurred.
If it is not taken out in time, death will undoubtedly occur within a month at most. "
Bai Wenyuan's face changed slightly: "Take it out? How to take it out?"
